Luxury 3-Bedroom Apartment in Sobha Crest Grande | High Floor | Payment Plan Available

Welcome to Sobha Crest Grande, where luxury meets lifestyle in the heart of Sobha Hartland. This high-floor, premium 3-bedroom apartment spans an impressive 1,618.78 sq.ft., offering spacious interiors and stunning panoramic views of the city skyline and Dubai Water Canal.

The unit features:

3 Generously-Sized Bedrooms
4 Modern Bathrooms
2 Dedicated Parking Spaces
Unfurnished – Ready for you to design to your taste
Floor-to-Ceiling Windows enhancing natural light and views

Set within a world-class development, Sobha Crest Grande is known for its superior finishes, state-of-the-art amenities, and prime location just minutes away from Downtown Dubai and Meydan. Residents enjoy access to a fully equipped gym, swimming pool, kids’ play area, retail outlets, and lush landscaped surroundings.

Don’t miss your chance to own a piece of luxury in one of Dubai’s most prestigious communities — Sobha Crest Grande is waiting for you.
